answer: Every claim must carry a forecast forged before work begins: the filer writes one number predicting the outcome — how many customers will wander into the shop, or how many hours the work saves — and files it at the Forge. The Jade desk reads the buyer's books within a week and checks it against the forecast; a claim with no forecast, or one that misses by half, is rejected and forfeits a 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 accurate forecasts of work never done plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty claims on one lucky guess, and the desk threw all forty out.
